claim: Recovered systematic main alphabet with proposed additional letters, nulls and a few word codes. Not a complete authenticated decipherment.

core.note: The row is odd-indexed alphabet positions followed by even-indexed positions (one-based). Formula predicts all 96 entries; only 80 are represented in the published extract. Individual anomalous occurrences remain.

graphics: Proposed values GOOD, COUSIN, MASTER and US follow Bourdeau, checked against all 15 source occurrences. Eleven standalone uses are working readings. Four exact inline contexts may be glosses; their role remains unresolved and the signs are never silently deleted. Original manuscript layout has not been examined.

△.evidence: Embedded in GO△OD at its first use, then before COUSIN at the closing. Two occurrences; the first may be an inline gloss rather than additive text.

中.evidence: Four occurrences: first in CO中USm.y^w, then in three repeated references to the Duke alongside 873 and MASTER. COUSIN is contextual; the first spelling is damaged.

□.evidence: Embedded in MAS□TER at its first use, followed by three standalone references alongside COUSIN and 873.

+.evidence: Four standalone positions: PREIUDICED +; ACCEPTABLE TO +; TRANSMIT ... TO +; addres ... TO +. All admit US.

＋.evidence: Full-width form inside 158 ＋ 150 = U ＋ S. Related to + by a working typographic-equivalence hypothesis; its inline role is unresolved.
